intro: Small in size but big in style—Harmony is the perfect blend of elegance and practicality. Whether enjoying a quiet coffee moment or displaying your favourite décor, it mixes into your living space.

features.title: A warm finish that feels like home
features.text: The warm walnut shade with a matte finish enhances your living space with sophistication, effortlessly complementing a variety of interior styles.

features.title: Smart storage, zero clutter
features.text: Thoughtfully designed open compartments provide a clutter-free way to store your essentials, keeping everything you need within arm’s reach.

features.title: Built to last, designed for everyday life
features.text: Built from robust 18mm prelaminated particle board, this table is made to endure everyday use while maintaining its elegance over time.

features.title: More surface, more possibilities
features.text: Despite its compact size, the table offers generous surface space for coffee, books, or décor, making it versatile for any occasion.

features.title: Easy setup, effortless style
features.text: Its flat-pack design ensures simple and quick assembly, transforming your living space with minimal effort.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
